The tip of the elephant's trunk; Mātaṅga

पुष्करायते [puṣkarāyatē], Den. Ā. To act as a drum.
पुष्करिका [puṣkarikā], A kind of disease (abscess on the penis).
A piece of water, lake or pool in general; ततः पुष्करिणीं वीरौ पम्पां नाम गमिष्यथ
पुष्करिन् [puṣkarin], a. (-णी f.) Abounding in lotuses. -m. An elephant.
पुष्कल [puṣkala], a. [पुष्-कलच् किच्च; पुष्कसिध्मा˚ लच् वा Tv.]

Alms to the extent of four morsels of food.

Strength, fatness, fulness, plumpness; अन्धस्य दृष्टिरिव पुष्टिरिवातुरस्य
Wealth, property, means of comfort; तस्मिन्नपुष्यन्नुदिते समग्रां पुष्टिं जनाः पुष्य इव द्वितीये

A particular disease of the eyes.

The car or vehicle of Kubera; see पुष्पक.
Expanding, blooming, blossoming (said to be m. in this sense).-Comp. -अग्रम् pistil.
